title: Adventure Studio Document, Workspace & Authority Contract
objective: Establish the creator-facing Adventure Studio document/workspace and authority contract that binds prepared Adventure content to existing CSW, CNI, Adventure, Scene, Session, Quest, World, Character, Encounter, Action/Event and resource owners through explicit references and proposals while preserving the boundary between prepared definitions and live runtime occurrences.
roadmap_prerequisites: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json MAS start gate re-evaluated after CNI-11 completion
CSW/Adventure/Scene/Session contracts and ARI remain required upstream authorities and are not replaced by MAS

scope.purpose: Define the first MAS workspace/document contract and authority boundaries for Adventure authoring without creating a second narrative runtime or canonical owner-domain store.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically represent an Adventure-authoring document and prepared content bindings, distinguishes draft/prepared/published projections from live occurrences, references existing owner-domain objects without duplicating their authority, preserves CSW/CNI/ARI/D29 boundaries, and exposes unsupported or invalid bindings without silently mutating canonical state.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json is the current cross-program sequence authority and was reconsulted before MAS-01 governed start.
MAS became milestone-eligible when CNI-11 completed_verified; the program-local CNI-12 successor cannot skip this eligible interstitial program.
Legacy MAS activation_after, placement and required_upstream prose are planning provenance/compatibility only where they conflict with ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json.
The application validation family transitions once from CNI to MAS at this family boundary and prior-family automatic validation remains retired.

CSW remains pre-authoritative creative/storycraft workspace; CNI remains modular conditional-content/runtime authority; Adventure/Scene/Session/Quest/World/Character/Encounter/Action/Event owners remain canonical authorities.
Prepared scenes, clues, encounters, rewards and timed events never silently become live-state occurrences.
Imported/generated resources preserve ARI identity/provenance/rights and authoring provenance preserves D29 boundaries.
Visibility filtering applies before search, counts, topology, diagnostics, optional-AI context and export; AI remains proposal-only.
CNI-12, PCA, MAS-02+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized while MAS-01 is in progress.
next_action: On the authorized application branch, perform the one-time CNI-to-MAS validation-family transition, establish causal MAS-01 RED, then implement the minimum deterministic Adventure Studio document/workspace and authority contract.
